Four named harnesses currently carry the Supported badge. This page is membership only. The full ledger, Restricted identities, Open derivation targets, and Corrected walk-backs live on the claim ledger. A green residual is not Einstein.

Do not file a Supported discrete or scalar harness as a gravity theorem or as Einstein’s equations. v12.41 moment-map closure is Restricted, not this list. Gravity’s constraints have not been identified.

Literature objects on this page: BKM (Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori), Codazzi–Mainardi, KKS. Program laws (internal names, not standard theorems): Genesis Pin, QRSL, HCPR, QMAR, g★. Do not treat QRSL as if it were in Amari.
